mentions.name: ESP32 toddler music player
mentions.description: A DIY music player built for the author's 2-year-old son, using an ESP32, SD card reader, GC9A01 round LCD, PCM5102A DAC, and XH-A232 amplifier in a 3D-printed enclosure. A custom UI is currently being developed, with plans to add Bluetooth speaker support, web-based configuration, and OTA updates.
mentions.problem: Premade kids' audio toys like the Yoto player exist, but the author preferred building one himself.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A music player for my 2 years old son. There are premade toys like Yoto player. But what is the fun in buying ready made?

esp32+sdcard reader+gc9a01 lcd and a pcm5102a+xh-a232 (overkill 30W! solution! Will replace in time)

Add some 3d printed enclosure and you are done. I am currently vibe coding a UI into it. I am planning to cram in adsp Bluetooth speaker support and some web config, maybe ota updates..
